name: SmithAI
desc:
Virtual Receptionist |$15/hr ($16 for Spanish bilingual | 
Answer calls for a variety of different businesses and professionals
Take messages, screen new clients, book appointments, collecting payments, and transfer calls
Understand the caller’s needs and provide business information
Must type 40 wpm and have your own computer/laptop with Google Chrome browser installed. 
Predictable Scheduling
‍We operate 24/7/365. We offer flexible hours with a requirement to work one shift on Monday and a minimum of 25 hours per week up to 40 hours per week. Our scheduling offers set hours, providing a level of predictability for our agents and contributes to a positive work/life balance. Shifts are broken into 2- to 5-hour blocks, and are scheduled based on the business needs of Smith.ai and its clients, as well as your availability

For U.S.-based agents
Starting, entry-level rate of $15/hour
Starting, entry-level rate of $16/hour for bilingual agents who speak fluent English and Spanish
Paid training
Healthcare benefits available for agents working 30+ hours weekly
assessment: Yes. The application link goes directly to OnDemand Assessment, meaning candidates complete a skills-based assessment as part of the application itself, before any live interview
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not stated in posting.
 Required Experience: Experienced call-handling background implied by posting language ("experienced call-handling professionals"), though no specific years are listed.
 Preferred Experience: Bilingual English/Spanish candidates are noted to qualify for a higher pay tier.
 Required Skills:
Strong typing (minimum 40 WPM) and multitasking
Confident, professional phone communication in English
Comfort navigating new client accounts and instructions quickly
Proficient computer use with Google Chrome installed
Reliable broadband internet meeting minimum speed requirements (under 50ms ping, 10+ Mbps download, 3+ Mbps upload)
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone who already has call-handling or receptionist experience and enjoys variety over routine
Participants who are quick learners comfortable adjusting to different client accounts and scripts throughout a single shift
Bilingual candidates, since English/Spanish fluency qualifies for a higher starting pay rate
Anyone who wants predictable, block-scheduled hours (2-5 hour shifts) rather than an unpredictable on-call structure
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants who prefer supporting one single company or product rather than juggling multiple client accounts
Anyone without their own qualifying computer (minimum 8GB RAM, Chrome browser, minimum display resolution) and broadband internet already in place
Someone who can't commit to at least 25 hours a week including a required Monday shift
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Virtual receptionist
Call handling
Multi-client support
Appointment scheduling
Message taking
Payment processing
Call screening
Customer service
Remote reception
Bilingual (if applicable)
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 The application itself routes directly to an OnDemand Assessment (a skills-based screening tool), meaning candidates complete this assessment as part of applying, before any live interview happens. Confirm additional steps directly, but expect this early assessment step to be a real gatekeeper given the company's low overall acceptance rate.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me about your experience handling calls for multiple different clients or accounts.
How do you quickly get up to speed on a new client's specific instructions or script?
Describe a time you had to multitask between typing notes and staying engaged in a phone conversation.
How do you stay calm and professional when switching between very different types of calls back to back?
What does your home workspace and equipment setup look like for a fully remote phone-based role?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: Starting at $15.00/hr for U.S.-based agents, $16.00/hr for bilingual English/Spanish. Outside salary data shows total pay (including bonuses and raises with tenure) can trend notably higher over time, with a reported median around $28/hr for experienced agents, though that reflects long-term averages, not starting pay.

Shift: 100% remote, flexible scheduling within a 24/7 operation. Minimum 25 hours/week (including one required Monday shift) up to 40 hours/week. Shifts scheduled in 2-5 hour blocks based on business need and availability.

Benefits: Paid training, healthcare benefits for agents working 30+ hours/week, employee referral bonus program, team award opportunities.

Equipment Provided: No. This is a bring-your-own-equipment role: personal computer with Google Chrome, minimum 8GB RAM, minimum 1024x768 display resolution, plus a headset with an attached microphone arm.

Felony Friendly?: Not clearly stated. The posting only specifies "ability to pass a background check" without detailing what would or wouldn't disqualify someone. Confirm directly, don't assume flexibility either way.

Drug Test: Not stated in posting.

Notes: This company is notably selective, they state they hire less than 1% of applicants, so set realistic expectations with participants that this isn't a guaranteed-hire type of role despite low formal experience requirements. The application routes straight into a skills assessment (OnDemand Assessment), so encourage participants to be well-rested and focused when they sit down to apply, this functions as the real first screening step. Home equipment and internet requirements are specific and must be met upfront, this isn't a company-provided-equipment role.

Career Pathway: Virtual Receptionist → Senior Virtual Receptionist → Team Lead → Quality/Training Specialist → Account Executive (client-facing sales track, reported to pay significantly higher based on outside salary data)
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
